card.text: A barred spiral galaxy 9.5 million parsecs away, tilted 54° to our line of sight.

introduction.text: It is one of the largest spiral galaxies near us in the southern sky. It lies 26° from the plane of the Milky Way, so thousands of our galaxy's stars stand in front of it.
